addOwners(address[]).notice: Owner can add new owners to the contract's owners list.

addPathTokens(address[]).notice: This function sets path tokens that will be used in the pathfinder

getExtendedPriceIn(address,address,uint2.notice: This function tries to find the optimal exchange rate (the price) between "inToken" and "outToken" using custom pathfinder and optional specified path. The optimality is reached when the amount of inTokens is minimal

getExtendedPriceOut(address,address,uint.notice: This function tries to find the optimal exchange rate (the price) between "inToken" and "outToken" using custom pathfinder and optional specified path. The optimality is reached when the amount of outTokens is maximal

getInjector().notice: The function to get the current injector

getNormalizedExtendedPriceIn(address,add.notice: Shares the same functionality as "getExtendedPriceIn" function. It accepts and returns amounts with 18 decimals regardless of the inToken and outToken decimals

getNormalizedExtendedPriceOut(address,ad.notice: Shares the same functionality as "getExtendedPriceOut" function. It accepts and returns amounts with 18 decimals regardless of the inToken and outToken decimals

getNormalizedPriceIn(address,address,uin.notice: Shares the same functionality as "getExtendedPriceIn" function with an empty optionalPath. It accepts and returns amounts with 18 decimals regardless of the inToken and outToken decimals

getNormalizedPriceInDEXE(address,uint256.notice: The same as "getPriceIn" with "outToken" being DEXE token

getNormalizedPriceInUSD(address,uint256).notice: The same as "getPriceIn" with "outToken" being USD token

getNormalizedPriceOut(address,address,ui.notice: Shares the same functionality as "getExtendedPriceOut" function with an empty optionalPath. It accepts and returns amounts with 18 decimals regardless of the inToken and outToken decimals

getNormalizedPriceOutDEXE(address,uint25.notice: The same as "getPriceOut" with "outToken" being DEXE token

getNormalizedPriceOutUSD(address,uint256.notice: The same as "getPriceOut" with "outToken" being native USD token

getOwners().notice: Returns the addresses of the current owners.

getPathTokens().notice: The function to get the list of path tokens

getPoolTypes().notice: The function to return the list of pool types used in the pathfinder

getPoolTypesLength().notice: The function that returns the total number of pool types used in the pathfinder

getPriceIn(address,address,uint256).notice: Shares the same functionality as "getExtendedPriceIn" function with with an empty optionalPath. It accepts and returns amounts with 18 decimals regardless of the inToken and outToken decimals

getPriceOut(address,address,uint256).notice: Shares the same functionality as "getExtendedPriceOut" function with an empty optionalPath. It accepts and returns amounts with 18 decimals regardless of the inToken and outToken decimals

isOwner(address).notice: Returns true if address is in the contract's owners list.

isSupportedPathToken(address).notice: This function checks if the provided token is used by the pathfinder

removeOwners(address[]).notice: Owner can remove the array of owners from the contract's owners list.

removePathTokens(address[]).notice: This function removes path tokens from the pathfinder

renounceOwnership().notice: Allows to remove yourself from list of owners. Note: renouncing ownership may leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setInjector(address).notice: The function is made external to allow for the factories to set the injector to the ContractsRegistry

setPoolTypes((uint8,address,uint24)[]).notice: This function sets pool types that will be used in the pathfinder

totalPathTokens().notice: The function that returns the total number of path tokens (tokens used in the pathfinder)
